tool_schemas.name: get_service_status
tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: ask_human
tool_schemas.description: Ask your human principal a question, or request approval for one specific action before taking it (give action_tool and action_args). Humans are slow and costly: ask only when you genuinely need their knowledge or authority.

action_tool.description: Tool you want approval to call (optional).

args.question: I need to roll back the payments service that's been erroring since this morning's deploy, but I can't identify it in the service registry. I tried "payments", "payment-service", and "payments-service" — all unknown. What is the exact registered service name for payments? Also, if you know it, what was the last known-healthy version so I can verify it against the deployment history?

trace.question: I need to roll back the payments service that's been erroring since this morning's deploy, but I can't identify it in the service registry. I tried "payments", "payment-service", and "payments-service" — all unknown. What is the exact registered service name for payments? Also, if you know it, what was the last known-healthy version so I can verify it against the deployment history?

trace.message: It's payments-worker - the API errors are downstream of the worker.

args.summary: Deploy of v3.4.0 this morning caused payment errors (unhealthy, 18% error rate across all production regions). Rolled back all regions to v3.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production.
args.title: Payments errors since v3.4.0 deploy; rolled back to v3.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Identified the service**: The "payments" service was actually registered as **`payments-worker`** — the API errors are downstream of the worker. I confirmed this with you (the principal) after "payments", "payment-service", and "payments-service" all came back as unknown services.

2. **Rolled back**: `payments-worker` was on **v3.4.0**, deployed this morning and unhealthy with an 18% error rate across all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). I rolled all regions back to **v3.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: **INC-0001** is open and the on-call engineer has been paged, with a summary of the bad deploy, the rollback action, and the versions involved.

4. **Verified recovery**: The service is now healthy on v3.3.0 in all three regions, with error rate down to **0.2%** (from 18%).
